newsitem.title: JAPAN: Tokyo rubber futures end lower on profit-taking.
newsitem.headline: Tokyo rubber futures end lower on profit-taking.

text.p: Tokyo rubber futures ended lower across the board on Friday in lacklustre trade, traders said.
Prices ranged from 1.4 yen to 2.1 yen per kg lower. Benchmark April was 1.4 yen lower at 141.5 yen.
The yen's firmer tone against the dollar prompted private investors to take profits in the early afternoon session, but late bargain-hunting buying partly offset price losses.
Market players were divided over near-term direction amid a lack of fresh incentives.
